name: edit
description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.
servedDescription: Replace an exact piece of text in a UTF-8 file that already exists.

name: read
description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.
servedDescription: Read a UTF-8 text file. Each line comes back with its number.

name: skill
description: Load the full instructions for a skill. Call it before acting on a task that names or clearly matches a skill in the session skill catalog.
servedDescription: Open a skill's whole instructions. Use it first when a task names a skill from the session's skill catalog, or plainly fits one.
